title: Refterm v2 - Resource usage, binary splat, glyph sizing, and more
summary: Casey Muratori follows up his refterm proof-of-concept, a GPU-based terminal renderer, with a second part covering memory usage, glyph sizing and correct Unicode and VT handling. It is built to show that a terminal can be fast and correct without heroic effort.
why: HN points to it as proof that a small, straightforward renderer can beat Windows Terminal on speed and memory, whenever software slowness comes up.

quote.text: Casey Muratori produced a highly correct Unicode renderer with correct VT code support. Watch the video
